design.name: dgx-superpod-512
design.description: 2-SU NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD (RA-11336-001 V2, DGX H200), modelled as IaC

hall.note: Air-cooled H200 (no CDU): hot-aisle containment with end doors and roof panels, cold supply from CRAH/fan walls at the row ends; overhead Starline busway per power path (A/B/C), ladder rack and yellow fibre raceway above each row.
